**Ash Cave** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

A cave that was used by the Ash Cavers, a Raider group led by Professor Franklin Metter after the war.

- Herman and the Professor - Note, on a metal stand south of the Stash Box, on the southwestern end of the camp.
- Meditations on Enhancement - Note, on a desk in the northern Quonset hut with the three Chemistry Stations inside, and a Cooking Station outside.
- Meditations on Light - Note, on a green table, inside the Quonset hut west of the Stash Box, on the southwestern end of the camp.
- Meditations on Tempering - Note, two copies:
 - One on a white console near the Fusion Generator, on the western end of the central Quonset hut.
 - One on a metal stand at the barricade, on the tower south of the Weapons Workbench.
- Meditations on Wind - Note, three copies:
 - One on a blue barrel next to the Stash Box, on the southwestern end of the camp.
 - One on a metal shelf in a shack next to two wind generators, on the western cliff overlooking the camp.
 - One on a Metal Box next to a black console, at a single wind generator due northeast of the camp.
- Professor Metter's Log - Holotape, in Professor Metter's room above his skeleton, accessible through a Security Door upstairs.
- Professor Metter's Password - Key, two copies:
 - One inside the console to the left of the skeleton of Professor Franklin Metter, on the western end of the central Quonset hut.
 - One on a metal shelf in a shack next to two wind generators, on the western cliff overlooking the camp.
- The Professor - Note, on a makeshift table next to some beds, inside the Quonset hut west of the Stash Box, on the southwestern end of the camp.
- Power Armor Chassis - Next to Professor Metter's throne.

Ash Cave appears in *Fallout 76*.
